decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
event_name: Date 29 September 2019 Time 11:58 2019 RUSSIAN GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 32), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The floor has been changed and is of a different specification.
offence: Breach of Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The changed floor is of a different specification from the one used during qualifying, the floor was replaced with the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate as per Article 34.2. As the floor is a different specification and was changed whilst the car was in parc ferme, the competitor is required to start the race from the pit lane per Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 23 Change Of Floor
